correctness.rationale: Vieta gives an if-and-only-if characterization of degree-k root sets by the sum -eta^{-1}; distinct full-field evaluations are injective because k<p. Exact cyclic zero-run counting identifies the unique forbidden interval mechanism, and the rank-k−1 Vandermonde minor supplies the reverse distance bound. The two changed k-windows under a single swap are evaluated exactly and cannot retain the forbidden sum when 2≤k≤p−2; for k=p−1 every k-window is the complement of one point. The all-prime proof handles endpoints and quantifiers; independent direct codeword enumeration checked 354,480 nonzero messages in 54 whole instances and all 360 orders for p=5.

value.rationale: Ordered overlapping-read metrics matter operationally in symbol-pair and b-symbol channels. The same non-Hamming-MDS code is precisely defect-one across all short b-windows in an arithmetic ordering and simultaneously MDS at all b≥2 after exchanging only adjacent coordinates. The exact forbidden-sum characterization, minimum-layer multiplicity, and dimension p−1 impossibility boundary provide a motivated structural classification for infinitely many prime-field codes beyond a mere tabulation or the general Singleton inequality.
